newsitem.title: CHINA: China foreign debt hits $116.28 bln at end-1996.
newsitem.headline: China foreign debt hits $116.28 bln at end-1996.

text.p: China borrowed $30.95 billion from overseas sources in 1996, bringing its total outstanding foreign debt to $116.28 billion at the end of last year, the official Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
Total outstanding debt was up $9.69 billion, or 9.1 percent from 1995, Xinhua quoted the State Administration of Foreign Exchange as saying.
Medium and long-term foreign loans rose by $7.49 billion, or 7.9 percent, to hit $102.17 billion, or 87.9 percent of total debt, Xinhua said.
Short term loans rose $2.19 billion, or 18.4 percent, over 1995 to hit $14.11 billion, it said but gave no further details.
China's foreign debt stood at $109.57 billion at the end of June 1996, up 6.3 percent compared with the same period a year before, official figures show.
